verdict.rationale: Firebase exposes rich documented public APIs (Firestore, Auth, Functions, Realtime DB, Security Rules) plus SDKs, a CLI (firebase-tools, confirmed working headlessly via probe), and an official MCP server with a verified hands-on JSON-RPC handshake, all enabling AI-native/agentic driving of the product. missing for 10: no public OpenAPI/REST spec (openapi probes 404) and no llms.txt discovery file, so machine-readable API discovery is incomplete despite strong SDK/CLI/MCP coverage.
